zh-CN.name: 应用开发与发布
zh-CN.summary: 开发个人工作台并发布到我的应用，按需分发固定版本
zh-CN.description: 用户要求开发、修改或发布自己的工作台应用，或把固定应用版本分发到 GitHub/Gitea 与 Registry 时使用。按所选技术栈使用的外部 Node/Docker 运行时、托管、Git 服务和数据库须有真实环境或连接及适用条款，可能另行部署或收费；缺能力时说明原因。

en-US.name: Application Development and Publishing
en-US.summary: Develop a personal workbench, publish it to My Apps, and distribute fixed releases on request
en-US.description: Use when the user asks to develop, modify or publish a personal workbench application, or distribute a fixed release through GitHub/Gitea and Registry. Node/Docker runtimes, hosting, Git services and databases used by the chosen stack need actual environments or connections and applicable terms; separate deployment or costs may apply. Report unavailable capabilities.
